source: sars-guide:SARS PAYE-GEN-01-G21 Guide for Employers iro Employees Tax 2027, Revision 1 p. 4 (rate) and the SARS FAQ on reimbursed travel (treatment)
notes: Salary R20 000 and 1 000 business km reimbursed at the prescribed R4.95/km (G21 p. 4, 2027): R4 950, not remuneration (code 3703), no other travel compensation. PAYE on 20 000 = 2 115.00; UIF 177.12; net 20 000 + 4 950 - 2 115 - 177.12 = 22 657.88. The treatment (3703 excluded) is the SARS FAQ on reimbursed travel: not above the rate fixed by the Minister and no other compensation = non-taxable, code 3703.
